A.summary: A = antisymmetric subspace {u* = -u}; I2 is degree-preserving (printed codomain n+1 is a slip). Intended base case is ER's v.b.u: only it makes ER Thm 9.2 / Hetyei eq. (5.1), Thm 32, Cor 33, M-symmetry and Prop 5.12 consequences true; the conjecture fails at n = 5 under it. Under the misprint the conjecture fails trivially (A not in ker from n = 2): an artefact with no credit. MathDB 347230 is faithful; MathDB 347231 misdefines L as (a-b)u (the source's L is (a-b)u + u(a-b)); refutation robust to both.

B.kernel_printed: 0 for n = 1..7 (A not contained in ker for n >= 2)
B.certificate: lane's 20-term u (transcription identical to outputs/hetyei-certificates-v2.json): u* = u, u != 0, I2(u) = 0 under ER; ker(I2|S5) is spanned by u; printed reading gives I2(u) = -8abaab + 8ababa + 8baaab - 8baaba
B.validation: ER M agrees with Psi(PxQ) on 70 poset pairs; ER I2 agrees with brute-force interval transform on 29 posets and on all doubled chains (spanning) for degree <= 5; printed reading fails all of these
B.companion_347231: eigenvectors in S_n span 2/2, 3/3, 5/6, 7/10, 13/20 (n = 1..5); I2(aab + baa) not symmetric; Lemma 36 false at L(Psi B3), also not an eigenvector modulo A; first non-eigen composition is L.Pyr.Pyr(1)
